summary: Whole-game interaction re-check (acceptance r2). I drove the real game at 1920x1080, with an audit pass at 1280x720 and 2560x1440, in three ways: keyboard only (fresh profile, no autoplay flag), mouse only, and a fake standard gamepad polled by core Input, plus window.__br. There were 14 probes; logs and sheets are in shots/accept/r2-interaction/ (p1a-p9 .log, sheet1-3.jpg). The machine load average was 30+ during the run. Both r1 majors are fixed. (1) The d-pad steers: x -2.0 -> +3.4 -> -2.7 m for 0.9 s of right then left (p2.log D4). (2) The career finale works: the last event at 1st shows '★ 巡回赛通关 CAREER CLEAR!', pays +1000, and 通关！ opens the credits finale; Esc returns to the ladder, which shows 3 CLEAR! stamps and the 巡回赛通关 chip, and all of it survives a reload. A 5th place on the final event disables 下一站 with an accurate denial (p3.log). r1 minors fixed: HUD pad glyphs (LB/✚↑/✚↓/R3), START on the title, intro skip chip, quitting a career race returns to its ladder event, Tab and right-click / mouse-back handling, settings clamp and mute-by-click, the records sheet, the title glyph clip, and a shorter restart (intro after 1.9 s). Everything else in the lens holds. Every screen backs out with Esc / Backspace / right-click / the ESC hint. Focus is always visible, and the overflow audit is clean at all three sizes. Garage buy/equip works by key, click and pad. Every settings row and quality low/medium/high persist through the restart offer. Pause resume/restart/quit work, and results -> 下一站 / 再来一局 work. Mashing never double-starts: Enter mashed for 14 s from the title gives 1 start, 7 restart confirms give 1 restart, Esc mashed in the race leaves the clock consistent, and the hop rhythm across the line never arms the results. Audio unlocks on the first key or click. Saves survive a reload byte for byte. 0 console errors in every probe, and tsc is clean. Not a pass, because of two new pad-side majors. (1) The results screen ignores Space and pad A at any steady cadence faster than 1 press/s, even after the row is armed: 14 presses at 0.8 s did nothing. This is a regression from the r1 hop-twin fix. (2) On the records sheet, pad B and pad A do nothing, although its footer says '[LB] [B] 收起'. Minors: the in-game 减弱 motion setting does not reach race visuals (slams, flashes, inverted frames); there is still no quit and no macOS app menu; the desktop shell grabs Ctrl+Cmd+F system-wide; the quick-race track choice is forgotten on reload; some copy is keyboard-only; title art can still appear half-painted on a slow cold start; there are no cup/career achievements; changing 画质 needs a full page reload.

issues.title: Results screen ignores Space / pad A (the hinted confirm) at any steady press cadence under 1 s, even after the row is armed
issues.detail: p5c.log K2/K3: coast quick race, finish, then press Space (K2) or pad A (K3) every 0.79 s from the moment the results appear. The row arms at 1.7 s and the focus is on 主菜单, but none of the 14 presses over the next 10 s does anything: the screen stays on results with no sound and no visual feedback. A single press made >1 s after the previous one works (p2.log D6). Cause: results.ts drops every confirm that arrives as a hop twin (Space / pad A) while ctx.pressGap() < HOP_CONFIRM_GAP (1000 ms). Each rejected press refreshes the gap, so an impatient player who re-presses A every 0.5-0.9 s never gets out. Arming already waits for a 700 ms quiet beat (QUIET_MS), so this second guard is redundant and also catches deliberate presses. On a pad, A is the only confirm, and results is the hub between every race. This regression came with the r1 e2e#8 fix.
issues.fix: results.ts: compare the hop-twin gap only for the first press after arming, and only against the last press made before arming. Once one hop-twin confirm has been rejected after arming, accept the next one if it comes >= 350 ms later. On a rejected press, play ui.deny and pulse the focused button, so the player can see the row is live. Add ui-input checks: Space and pad A at a 0.8 s cadence after arming leave results within 2 presses, and the 450 ms hop rhythm across the line still never arms the row.

issues.title: Records sheet cannot be closed with pad B or pad A (or Space), although its footer reads '[LB] [B] 收起'
issues.detail: p2.log D1, fake standard pad at 1920x1080: career -> LB opens the 成就 RECORDS sheet. B leaves it open, and so does A; only START closes it (as do LB/RB, Esc, Enter and Tab). While the sheet is open, every other press is eaten, so d-pad + A on the ladder do nothing and the game looks frozen. My first two pad runs hung right there. Cause: career.ts onAction returns true for every action while records.open. Pad B emits attackR before back, and pad A emits hop before confirm (core PADMAP order), so the twin is consumed first and the shell's one-action-per-press swallow drops the real back/confirm. Keyboard Space (hop + confirm) is dead there for the same reason. The results achievement panel already handles this correctly by returning false for non-menu actions.
issues.fix: career.ts onAction while the sheet is open: on back/confirm/pause/tab, close the sheet and return true. For directions, return true. For every other action (attackR, hop, heavy…), return false so the twin's back/confirm still arrives. Add a ui-input pad case: LB opens, B closes, LB opens, A closes, and the d-pad then moves the ladder focus.

issues.title: In-game 动态效果 = 减弱 only calms menus; races keep full HUD slams, flash frames, inverted impact frames and shake
issues.detail: p7b1.log vs p7b2.log, same test KO (fx.testKo) on coast. With the in-game 减弱 setting and no OS flag: KO splash max scale 1.9, post flash 0.30, inverted impact frame 0.026 s. With OS prefers-reduced-motion: max scale 1.05, flash 0.11, no impact frame. p7a.log: fx.post.reducedFlashes stays false under 减弱. The preference lives only in ui-screens' localStorage key 'beak-rash.motion'. hud/anim.ts, fx/system.ts (reducedFlashes, read once at creation) and camera/rig.ts check only matchMedia. A photosensitive player who picks 减弱 in the game still gets full-strength flashes and inverted frames. ui-screens filed the core request (Settings.motion) in acceptance round 1, and it is still open.
issues.fix: core: add Settings.motion ('system'|'reduced'|'full') to SaveData and sanitize it. Expose one helper, e.g. app.reducedMotion(), that combines it with the media query and fires a bus event when it changes. Then fx/system.ts reducedFlashes, ui-hud hud/anim.ts reducedMotion() and camera/rig.ts shake read it, and ui-screens swaps p5/motion-pref.ts over to the save.

issues.title: Still no way to quit from inside the game (r1 #13 only half done)
issues.detail: Core added AppContext.quit(), which is set when the game runs in the desktop shell. But the main menu (ui/copy.ts MENU, menu.ts) never shows a 退出游戏 QUIT entry. desktop/main.cjs still calls Menu.setApplicationMenu(null), so in the macOS build Cmd+Q and Cmd+H do nothing. In F11 fullscreen the only way out is to leave fullscreen and click the window's close button.
issues.fix: menu.ts: when ctx.app.quit exists, append '退出游戏 QUIT'. It should ask ctx.confirm('退出游戏？', …) and then call app.quit(). Esc on the menu keeps going to the title. Main session: in desktop/main.cjs, replace setApplicationMenu(null) with a minimal macOS menu ({role:'appMenu'}, {role:'editMenu'}, {role:'windowMenu'}), then repackage.

issues.title: Desktop shell grabs Cmd/Ctrl+Control+F as a system-wide global shortcut
issues.detail: desktop/main.cjs calls globalShortcut.register('CommandOrControl+Control+F', …), which takes that key combo for the whole OS for as long as the game is open. On macOS, Ctrl+Cmd+F is the standard Enter Full Screen shortcut in every app. While the game sits in the background, Safari, Finder or an editor can no longer toggle fullscreen: the handler finds no focused game window and does nothing. F11 is already handled per window through before-input-event.
issues.fix: Drop globalShortcut. Handle the combo in the existing before-input-event handler (input.meta && input.control && input.key.toLowerCase() === 'f'), or give the new macOS app menu a {role:'togglefullscreen'} item.

issues.title: Quick-race track choice (and the menu cursor) reset on every launch
issues.detail: p8.log at 1280x720: I picked 落日山道 (card 03) in 快速比赛, played, quit and reloaded. Track select opened on 01 again, and the main menu always opens on 巡回赛. ui/screens/memory.ts keeps remember()/recall() in module memory only. Everything else does survive the reload, byte for byte: the equipped bike, settings, motion pref, coins, career progress and the career focus.
issues.fix: Persist the last quick-race track: a small ui localStorage key in the style of p5/motion-pref.ts, or a core request for SaveData.ui = { track }. recall() it as track-select.ts's start index. Optionally do the same for the last menu item.

issues.title: Keyboard-only copy shown to gamepad players outside the HUD
issues.detail: In pad mode (.is-pad), the 操作 blurb on the main menu still reads 'J 往左扇，L 往右扇，K 用力扇。' (ui/copy.ts MENU). The pause controls sheet lists 转向 = 左摇杆 only, although the d-pad now steers (pause.ts CONTROLS). The HOWTO basics say '攒满 SP 就按 P：SHOWTIME，一锅端。' (data/strings.ts, owned by content). The HUD and hint bars already switch glyphs live.
issues.fix: menu.ts: render the blurb per device, with two spans toggled by .is-pad like keyGlyph(), e.g. 'X 往左扇，B 往右扇，Y 用力扇。'. pause.ts: change the pad label to '左摇杆 / ✚←→'. Ask content for a device-neutral HOWTO line, e.g. '攒满 SP 放 SHOWTIME（P / R3）'.

issues.title: Title key art can still be revealed half painted on a slow cold start
issues.detail: p1a.log and p1-title.png (sheet1.jpg top-left), fresh profile at 1920x1080 under load: the title settled 9.2 s after navigation while title.webp was still incomplete. 400 ms later, the right panel showed only the top strip of the art (goose head, pelican helmet) above a large black block, i.e. a partially downloaded image painted progressively. boot.ts starts the menu/garage/loading art downloads before the title preload, and caps the title decode at 1.5 s. title.ts caps artReady at 1.2 s. So a slow disk or server still reveals a broken-looking first screen.
issues.fix: boot.ts: start the title preload first, and queue the background warm-up only after it resolves or its cap expires. title/menu/garage: create the art at opacity 0 and fade it in (150 ms) on img.decode(). Until then, show the drawn hero vector already used as onFail, so a late image never appears half painted.

issues.title: No achievements for cup clears or the career clear
issues.detail: p3.log: after the final event at 1st (CAREER CLEAR stamp, +1000 bonus, finale credits), the save's achievements are only first_win, clutch, podium, pacifist and blowout. data/achievements.ts has 42 entries, all shown on the new records sheet, but none for clearing 菜鸟杯 / 内卷杯 / 鹈鹕神杯 or 巡回赛通关. So the game's biggest milestone shows no 成就解锁 chip and does not move the N/42 counter. ui-screens asked content for these in acceptance round 1 (status/ui-screens.md requests).
issues.fix: Add cup1/cup2/cup3/career achievements, with names and descriptions in the kind meme voice. Unlock them in gameplay/achievements on race:end when progress reports the first top-3 on a cup's last event (ui/progress.ts cupCleared/careerCleared). The records sheet and the results chips pick them up automatically.

issues.title: Changing 画质 needs a full page reload (boot + title again); mid-race it only shows a toast
issues.detail: p1b.log: after a quality change, leaving settings offers 重启, which calls location.reload(). The game boots again, shows the title again, and the AudioContext is suspended again. Changed from pause -> 设置, it only toasts '画质设置会在重启游戏后生效', and nothing offers the restart later. The levels do differ (p9.log: low turns shadows off), so the option is real, but commercial racers apply graphics presets live.
issues.fix: game.ts: apply quality at runtime when settings closes, between races or on resume. Toggle renderer.shadowMap.enabled and the lights' castShadow, recompute renderDpr, and resize the fx pipeline targets and particle caps (fx request). Apply any part that cannot change live at the next race start, instead of reloading the page, and make the toast say exactly when it takes effect.
